game.name: Fuel (Japan)
game.desc: Fuel is a racing game for Xbox 360 with a playing field of over 14,000 square kilometres. In an alternate present where the Earth has been ravaged by the effects of climate change, a new breed of road junkies is born. They compete in a new extreme sport for fuel. In a variety of hostile environments, the player must watch out for torrential rains, tornadoes, sandstorms, lightning and blizzards.
